trace.notes: Normalized the single URL input as a zbMATH resolver record, https://zbmath.org/853597. Local shell networking could not resolve api.zbmath.org, so browser/search resolution was used.

Resolved the exact record to the Cambridge chapter 'Recent Progress and Open Problems in Linearization Stability' by V. E. Moncrief, DOI 10.1017/CBO9780511524653.020, in Directions in General Relativity, pp. 195-209. The Cambridge landing page exposes only a Summary section and access controls; the direct chapter PDF endpoint redirects to the same get-access/summary page instead of a readable PDF.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted. Bounded exact-work recovery attempted the zbMATH identifier 853597, exact title searches, exact title plus PDF/filetype:pdf, DOI 10.1017/CBO9780511524653.020, the Cambridge PDF filename 9780511524653c17_p195-209_CBO.pdf, and the Cambridge content hash AD8DBC80211D00A1851F04990F910AD7. Inspected candidates were Cambridge get-access pages, book/catalog records, library metadata, or unrelated works; none provided readable full text for the same chapter.

Source adequacy gate failed: no readable primary PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. No questions were extracted from the title, resolver metadata, publisher summary, search snippets, or catalog records.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-853597.json and outputs/latest.json.
